Map credits

Elevation: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / AWS Open Data. Norway data © Kartverket. Europe data includes Copernicus EU-DEM funded by the European Union, USGS GMTED2010 and SRTM, NOAA ETOPO1, and © Environment Agency 2015.

Coastlines, countries, rivers and lakes: Natural Earth, public domain. Elevation is exaggerated for the illustrative view.

New maritime engravings generated for Northbound with OpenAI image generation, guided by the supplied visual references. Architecture, Hekla volcano, vehicles, trees, houses, lighthouses and rocks are original upright isometric paper illustrations generated for this map. Their ground contacts avoid drawn river banks. Mountain relief, terrain pigments and river ribbons follow geographic data, with natural rock hatching and no elevation contour bands. Landmark research and artistic placement adjustments are recorded in the project sources.

Map rendering: Three.js, MIT license. DM Sans / Playfair Display fonts: SIL Open Font License.
